objective_summary.value: The investigation aims to better understand the structure and stability of laminar diffusion flames in microgravity. Specific goals include determining liftoff velocity limits, evaluating fuel dilution effects, quantifying microgravity effects on flame length and radiative heat loss, and validating numerical models.
objective_summary.quote: Objective: The objective of this investigation is to better understand the structure and stability of laminar diffusion flames in microgravity.

earth_applications.value: Improved numerical models for flame behavior lead to more efficient combustion technologies on Earth and aid in designing cleaner engines and industrial burners.
